text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ever since the paparazzi incident, Tap Dance City and her two companions had gained quite a reputation around the academy as the "Jack-of-All-Trades Trio."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Shakur!
I brought in another new request!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not doing it. Don't care.
Stop coming around to drag me into shit every single time!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, I bet you'll get some fascinating data out of it!
This request is to help find a lost charm dropped somewhere along the obstacle course!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A genuine treasure hunt...! Once we find it, we'll get to witness a horse girl's precious, blessed smile...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That last request was a blast!
We returned a cherished treasure to its owner and made everybody happy.
choice_data_list: Word of your exploits has been spreading lately.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Those two...
they're seriously amazing, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Shakur's our master strategist.
No matter how tricky the problem, she stays cool, spots the thread, and maps out a full plan to solve it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And Digital puts her whole heart into every request more than anyone.
When push comes to shove, even in spots where I'd hesitate, she boldly pulls off the craziest solutions without batting an eye!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: They're the best crew ever. With those two by my side, I feel like we could pull off something huge down the road!
choice_data_list: (...They really do make a great trio.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—I happened to run into the three of them out on a mission, searching for a kitten being cared for by one of the students.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Found ya, little kitty.
Alright, time to head back home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At that moment, the kitten perched on the handrail slipped, tumbling toward the pond—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Look out!?
I-If it has come to this—Digi-tan DIIIIVE!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the nick of time, Agnes Digital caught the kitten and tossed it safely toward the grass.
However, in doing so, she was about to fall into the pond herself—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Tch, grab on! Digital!!

text_block_list.name: Client
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I'm so glad Tora's safe...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No no... the gratitude is all mine, or rather—
To be blessed with such an impromptu handshake event... I am profoundly humbled, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I was thrilled too!
After all, I managed to save my "partner" from a nasty pinch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyo—HYOEEEEH!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Digital? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
P-P-Partner, you say...?! Please spare me!
Such an undeserved power word is going to make Digi-tan explode...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Just being able to contribute to the happiness of umamusume-chans and gaze upon you two divine beings is already an unexpected, ultimate, supreme joy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway—I shall make my ninja exit for today! *Poof*!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What's with her?
She didn't have to be that shy about it—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Shy, huh.
You really think it's somethin' that shallow?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No matter what kind of umamusume she's racin' against, she shows an all-around versatility. And at the root of that is the fact that she "stans" every single umamusume equally.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Meanin', there's no way in hell she'd ever view one specific person as special.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Everyone's special, which makes it totally flat. That's the logic rooted deep inside her.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Then... you're sayin' to her, we aren't special comrades or anything?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Special"? "Comrades"? I sure as hell never intended to become somethin' like that either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: All I want is you guys' data. ...Don't you forget it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like I just found myself a whole new romance!
Fine by me. If that's how you guys still feel—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then starting now, I'm gonna claim it!
A VIP seat called "Comrade" right inside your hearts!
choice_data_list: You really never waver, do you?
You really never waver, do you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then starting now, I'm gonna claim it!
A VIP seat called "Comrade" right inside your hearts!
choice_data_list: You really never waver, do you?
You really never waver, do you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Whether they're holdin' back or tryin' to act all cool, none of that matters to me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My mind's already made up!
You guys are my special crew!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If I want something, I take it—
I'm gonna do this the pirate way!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The locks on your hearts—
I'm definitely gonna pry 'em wide open!
